text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Something like this isn't really worth making a fuss about, is it?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"The strong prevail.
That's simply self-evident, after all."
choice_data_list: Yeah... But don't let your guard down.
Yeah... but don't let your guard down.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, how adorable.
Look at you getting so excited.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: "Still, as my Trainer, could you try to remain a little more composed?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
After all, the Umamusume you're training
is an absolute powerhouse.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course.
Constant victory is inevitable. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I'll push forward toward greater heights, becoming even stronger than I am now.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
To stand at the pinnacle of the world
as the absolute strongest.
